notes: בַּת־בְּלִיָּעַל is rendered attributively as *a wicked woman* (rule 28), the indefinite article going to the construct noun; לִפְנֵי fuses and takes *for*, headed on the construct (rules 23, 30).
עַד־הֵנָּה fuses into the single *hitherto*, headed on the morpheme carrying the deictic lexeme (rules 23, 30).
